FormModule.Name: ORDERS
FormModule.Title: Sales Orders
FormModule.Comment: Central order-entry module: header + line master-detail, status-transition buttons, and cross-form navigation to Customers/Inventory/Approvals.

ModuleParameter.Name: P_ORDER_ID
ModuleParameter.Comment: Optional: pre-filters the initial query when this form is opened with a specific order in mind.

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-FORM-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.G_USER := NVL(:GLOBAL.G_USER, GET_APPLICATION_PROPERTY(USERNAME));
 IF :PARAMETER.P_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('BK_ORDER', DEFAULT_WHERE, 'ORDER_ID = ' || :PARAMETER.P_ORDER_ID);
 GO_BLOCK('BK_ORDER');
 EXECUTE_QUERY;
 ELSE
 GO_BLOCK('BK_ORDER');
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-RECORD-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 -- Header fields that are either system-maintained (LOM-MOD-028) or only
 -- ever changed through a status-transition button, never typed directly.
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('BK_ORDER.STATUS', ENABLED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('BK_ORDER.SUBTOTAL', ENABLED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('BK_ORDER.TAX_AMOUNT', ENABLED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('BK_ORDER.TOTAL_AMOUNT', ENABLED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('BK_ORDER.APPROVAL_REQUIRED', ENABLED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('BK_ORDER.CREATED_BY', ENABLED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('BK_ORDER.CREATED_DATE', ENABLED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
END;

Trigger.Name: PRE-INSERT
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 -- LOM-MOD-013 (CONVERT, category A): same sequence-PK idiom as
 -- CUSTOMERS.fmb.
 IF :BK_ORDER.ORDER_ID IS NULL THEN
 :BK_ORDER.ORDER_ID := lom_order_id_seq.NEXTVAL;
 END IF;
 :BK_ORDER.STATUS := 'DRAFT';
 :BK_ORDER.WAREHOUSE_CODE := NVL(:BK_ORDER.WAREHOUSE_CODE, lom_inventory_api.default_warehouse);
 :BK_ORDER.CREATED_BY := :GLOBAL.G_USER;
 :BK_ORDER.CREATED_DATE := SYSDATE;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_can_place VARCHAR2(1);
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT customer_name INTO :BK_ORDER.CUSTOMER_NAME
 FROM lom_customers
 WHERE customer_id = :BK_ORDER.CUSTOMER_ID;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 om_shared.show_message('Customer ' || :BK_ORDER.CUSTOMER_ID || ' not found.');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END;

 -- LOM-MOD-019 (MOVE_TO_PLSQL_API, MEDIUM risk): calls
 -- LOM_CUSTOMER_API.can_place_order -- a clean single call site, so the
 -- rule itself is not duplicated. What moves in APEX is only the call
 -- site (item validation -> page process / dynamic action), not the logic.
 v_can_place := lom_customer_api.can_place_order(:BK_ORDER.CUSTOMER_ID);
 IF v_can_place = 'N' THEN
 om_shared.show_message('Customer ' || :BK_ORDER.CUSTOMER_ID
 || ' is not ACTIVE and cannot place new orders.');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
END;

Item.Name: STATUS
Item.Tooltip: Changed only via BT_SUBMIT / APPROVALS.fmb / release-ship processing, never typed -- see LOM-MOD-002.

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 -- LOM-MOD-024 (CONVERT, category A): CLEAR_FORM(NO_VALIDATE) +
 -- CREATE_RECORD is the standard legacy "new record" idiom. Maps
 -- directly to an APEX "Create" button that resets the page and starts a
 -- new row.
 CLEAR_FORM(NO_VALIDATE);
 GO_BLOCK('BK_ORDER');
 CREATE_RECORD;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 -- LOM-MOD-033 (CONVERT, category A): ENTER_QUERY/EXECUTE_QUERY toolbar
 -- buttons, repeated in spirit across all four modules. No business
 -- logic; becomes an Interactive Report search bar / Reset button.
 GO_BLOCK('BK_ORDER');
 ENTER_QUERY;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_button PLS_INTEGER;
BEGIN
 IF :BK_ORDER.STATUS != 'DRAFT' THEN
 om_shared.show_message('Only DRAFT orders can be submitted.');
 RETURN;
 END IF;

 -- LOM-MOD-034 (REPLACE_WITH_APEX_NATIVE, LOW risk): SHOW_ALERT
 -- confirmation, same pattern as APPROVALS.fmb's AL_CONFIRM_APPROVE /
 -- AL_CONFIRM_REJECT -- an APEX "Confirm" dynamic action replaces all
 -- three with no PL/SQL.
 v_button := SHOW_ALERT('AL_CONFIRM_SUBMIT');
 IF v_button != ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 RETURN;
 END IF;

 COMMIT_FORM;

 -- LOM-MOD-021 (PRESERVE): unlike APPROVALS.fmb's buttons, this is
 -- exactly what a modernized call site should look like -- one call to
 -- LOM_ORDER_API.submit_order, which itself calls recalc_order_totals,
 -- transition_status and (when needed) LOM_APPROVAL_API.create_approval_request.
 -- Nothing to change here except moving the call from a
 -- WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED trigger into an APEX page process.
 lom_order_api.submit_order(:BK_ORDER.ORDER_ID);
 COMMIT;
 om_shared.show_message('Order ' || :BK_ORDER.ORDER_ID || ' submitted.');
 EXECUTE_QUERY;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 ROLLBACK;
 om_shared.show_message('Submit failed: ' || SQLERRM);
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_paramlist PARAMLIST;
BEGIN
 v_paramlist := GET_PARAMETER_LIST('lom_nav_params');
 IF NOT Id_Null(v_paramlist) THEN
 DESTROY_PARAMETER_LIST(v_paramlist);
 END IF;
 v_paramlist := CREATE_PARAMETER_LIST('lom_nav_params');
 ADD_PARAMETER(v_paramlist, 'P_CUSTOMER_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, TO_CHAR(:BK_ORDER.CUSTOMER_ID));

 -- LOM-MOD-023 (REFACTOR, category D): same CALL_FORM navigation shape as
 -- LOM-MOD-020, simpler consequence (CUSTOMERS.fmb is read/write but has
 -- no order-specific state to lose) -- becomes a plain link to the
 -- Customer page in APEX, no manual review needed.
 CALL_FORM('CUSTOMERS', HIDE, NO_REPLACE, QUERY_ONLY, v_paramlist);
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_paramlist PARAMLIST;
BEGIN
 IF :BK_ORDER.STATUS NOT IN ('PENDING_APPROVAL', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED') THEN
 om_shared.show_message('This order has no approval history yet.');
 RETURN;
 END IF;

 v_paramlist := GET_PARAMETER_LIST('lom_nav_params');
 IF NOT Id_Null(v_paramlist) THEN
 DESTROY_PARAMETER_LIST(v_paramlist);
 END IF;
 v_paramlist := CREATE_PARAMETER_LIST('lom_nav_params');
 ADD_PARAMETER(v_paramlist, 'P_ORDER_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, TO_CHAR(:BK_ORDER.ORDER_ID));

 -- LOM-MOD-020 (MANUAL_REVIEW, category D): CALL_FORM hardcodes the
 -- target module name and blocks ORDERS until APPROVALS closes (modal,
 -- single-session MDI semantics). APEX has no direct equivalent -- a
 -- human has to choose between a modal dialog page, an inline region, or
 -- a plain navigation link, each with different state/UX trade-offs
 -- open_form_with_context (OM_SHARED.pll) cannot make for them.
 CALL_FORM('APPROVALS', HIDE, NO_REPLACE, QUERY_ONLY, v_paramlist);
END;

Trigger.Name: PRE-INSERT
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 -- LOM-MOD-017 (REFACTOR, MEDIUM risk): line numbering by inline
 -- MAX()+1 instead of a sequence. Safe under Forms' single-session
 -- record locking during data entry, but a real race condition once two
 -- APEX sessions can insert lines for the same order concurrently
 -- (e.g. two browser tabs, or a REST client alongside the UI).
 IF :BK_ORDER_LINE.LINE_NUMBER IS NULL THEN
 SELECT NVL(MAX(line_number), 0) + 1 INTO :BK_ORDER_LINE.LINE_NUMBER
 FROM lom_order_lines
 WHERE order_id = :BK_ORDER.ORDER_ID;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 SELECT product_name, unit_price
 INTO :BK_ORDER_LINE.PRODUCT_NAME, :BK_ORDER_LINE.UNIT_PRICE
 FROM lom_products
 WHERE product_id = :BK_ORDER_LINE.PRODUCT_ID
 AND active_flag = 'Y';
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 om_shared.show_message('Product ' || :BK_ORDER_LINE.PRODUCT_ID || ' not found or inactive.');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_available NUMBER;
BEGIN
 -- LOM-MOD-025 (MOVE_TO_PLSQL_API): re-derives availability with an
 -- inline SELECT against LOM_INVENTORY.QUANTITY_AVAILABLE instead of
 -- calling LOM_INVENTORY_API.get_available_qty, even though the virtual
 -- column means both reads return the same number today -- the risk is
 -- that a future change to "availability" (e.g. excluding damaged stock)
 -- only has one function to update, and this bypass would not see it.
 SELECT NVL(quantity_available, 0) INTO v_available
 FROM lom_inventory
 WHERE product_id = :BK_ORDER_LINE.PRODUCT_ID
 AND warehouse_code = :BK_ORDER.WAREHOUSE_CODE;

 -- LOM-MOD-026 (MOVE_TO_PLSQL_API, this lab's canonical example): the
 -- exact threshold check already exists as
 -- LOM_INVENTORY_API.validate_quantity, re-implemented here instead of
 -- called. A modernized page validation should call that function and
 -- surface its return value directly, not this inline comparison.
 IF :BK_ORDER_LINE.QUANTITY > v_available THEN
 om_shared.show_message('Only ' || v_available || ' unit(s) available for product '
 || :BK_ORDER_LINE.PRODUCT_ID || ' in warehouse ' || :BK_ORDER.WAREHOUSE_CODE);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 -- LOM-MOD-027 (MOVE_TO_PLSQL_API, HIGH risk): re-implements
 -- LOM_ORDER_API.calc_line_total's formula inline. This is a financial
 -- calculation with two independent implementations (also duplicated in
 -- DISCOUNT_AMOUNT's WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM below) -- the highest-risk
 -- duplication in this lab precisely because it affects money, not just
 -- a validation message.
 :BK_ORDER_LINE.LINE_TOTAL := ROUND(
 (:BK_ORDER_LINE.QUANTITY * :BK_ORDER_LINE.UNIT_PRICE) - NVL(:BK_ORDER_LINE.DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, 0), 2);
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 IF :BK_ORDER_LINE.DISCOUNT_AMOUNT < 0 THEN
 om_shared.show_message('Discount cannot be negative.');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 -- Second occurrence of the LOM-MOD-027 duplicate (see QUANTITY above):
 -- the same formula has to be repeated here too, or a discount entered
 -- after the quantity would leave LINE_TOTAL stale until some other
 -- item re-triggers the calculation. This repetition-on-every-input-item
 -- pattern is itself part of why LOM-MOD-027 is HIGH risk, not just the
 -- duplication against LOM_ORDER_API.calc_line_total.
 :BK_ORDER_LINE.LINE_TOTAL := ROUND(
 (:BK_ORDER_LINE.QUANTITY * :BK_ORDER_LINE.UNIT_PRICE) - NVL(:BK_ORDER_LINE.DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, 0), 2);
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_paramlist PARAMLIST;
BEGIN
 IF :BK_ORDER_LINE.PRODUCT_ID IS NULL THEN
 om_shared.show_message('Select a product line first.');
 RETURN;
 END IF;

 v_paramlist := GET_PARAMETER_LIST('lom_nav_params');
 IF NOT Id_Null(v_paramlist) THEN
 DESTROY_PARAMETER_LIST(v_paramlist);
 END IF;
 v_paramlist := CREATE_PARAMETER_LIST('lom_nav_params');
 ADD_PARAMETER(v_paramlist, 'P_PRODUCT_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, TO_CHAR(:BK_ORDER_LINE.PRODUCT_ID));
 ADD_PARAMETER(v_paramlist, 'P_WAREHOUSE_CODE', TEXT_PARAMETER, :BK_ORDER.WAREHOUSE_CODE);

 -- LOM-MOD-022 (REFACTOR, category D): OPEN_FORM keeps ORDERS open
 -- behind INVENTORY (non-modal multi-form session). APEX has no
 -- multi-form session to preserve -- becomes a link to a filtered
 -- Inventory page (new tab) or a modal region; no in-memory PARAMLIST
 -- state survives either way, so the parameters must travel as URL /
 -- page items instead.
 OPEN_FORM('INVENTORY', ACTIVATE, NO_QUERY_ONLY, v_paramlist);
END;

RecordGroup.Name: RG_CUSTOMER
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: SELECT customer_name, customer_id FROM lom_customers WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY 1

RecordGroup.Name: RG_PRODUCT
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: SELECT product_name, product_id, unit_price FROM lom_products WHERE active_flag = 'Y' ORDER BY 1

RecordGroup.Name: RG_WAREHOUSE
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: SELECT warehouse_name, warehouse_code FROM lom_warehouses WHERE active_flag = 'Y' ORDER BY 1
